newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria July industrial output down 1.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria July industrial output down 1.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Bulgarian state industrial output fell by a real 1.0 percent in July against the same month last year, National Statistics Institute (NSI) figures showed.
BULGARIA INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT JULY JUNE JULY'95

A decline in machine building, metallurgy, metal processing and food processing output did not outweigh a rise in nine other sectors, including energy, coal and building materials, electronic and electrotechnical equipment and chemical and oil processing, the NSI said.

The fledgeling private sector, which accounted for some 15 percent of the total industrial ouput of 138 billion levs last month, posted a real 11 percent rise compared to July 1995 and partly offset the fall in the state sector, the NSI said.
Output in the private industrial sector was also a real 20 percent up from January through July compared to the same period of 1995, the NSI said.

High interest on credits, the falling lev, the high-risk domestic economic environment, stagnation in the number of orders and the insolvency of clients were the main factors still hampering production, the NSI said. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
